reactor_type: horizontal hot wall tubular ALD reactor
evidence: The Y(iPrCp) 3/O 3 ALD process, studied at 270 °C with error bars representing standard deviation of film thickness across entire deposition area. During deposition, the amount of precursor dosage was controlled with the duration of the precursor pulse. The Ar gas purge time after Y(iPrCp) 3 pulse was fixed at 10 s.
